text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae suffered a narrow defeat. 
Seeing the outcome, Copano Rickey set her 
sights on the target race she would 
participate in next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae openly lamented her 
frustration. Meanwhile, Wonder Acute 
chuckled, saying how fun dirt racing is 
right now, and the two promised to race 
each other again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A great senior who has continuously run on 
the front lines of dirt racing, Wonder 
Acute. Hokko Tarumae rejoices at having 
grown enough to compete against her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And gearing up for her next battle at the 
JBC Classic, Hokko Tarumae made her move—!
